shortDescription: UPESSC Special TET 2026 Advertisement No. 03/2026. Online application begins 05 September 2026; written examination is scheduled for 03 November 2026.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has issued Advertisement No. 03/2026 for the Special Teacher Eligibility Test (Special TET) 2026.

The notice is for eligible working teachers and special teachers covered by the applicability conditions in the advertisement. It is an eligibility test, not a general vacancy notice.

Important Dates

  • Advertisement date: 03 September 2026
  • OTR / online application begins: 05 September 2026
  • Last date for online application fee: 04 October 2026
  • Last date for application correction: 08 October 2026
  • Written examination: 03 November 2026

Applicability

The notification covers teachers working at the primary and upper-primary levels in the government, local-body, aided and recognized school categories described in the notice. Special teachers covered by the notice must follow the stated RCI registration and certificate requirements.

Application

Applications are OTR-based and must be submitted through the UPESSC website. Check the official PDF for fee, eligibility, examination scheme and the exact information required before submitting.
